At Rootedrealm, customer satisfaction is important to us.
We accept eligible returns for both defective and non-defective products within our published 30-day return window.
This policy applies to purchases made from Rootedrealm within the United States.

Customers have 30 days from delivery to request an eligible return.

We accept eligible returns for non-defective products, including purchases that customers no longer want.

Direct exchanges are not accepted.

pages.title: Order Cancellations
intro: At Rootedrealm, we understand that customers may need to cancel an order.
pages.description: At Rootedrealm, we understand that customers may need to cancel an order.

blocks.text: Last Updated: November 17, 2026
At Rootedrealm, we understand that customers may need to cancel an order.
This policy explains the cancellation request process.
Contact customer service as soon as possible.
Please provide your order number and the name associated with your purchase.
Orders that have not yet been dispatched may be eligible for cancellation.
Cancellation depends on whether fulfillment can still be stopped.
A request is not confirmed until our team communicates approval.
Our standard processing period is 1–2 business days.
Contact us promptly if you need to cancel an order during this period.
Once an order has shipped, cancellation may no longer be possible.
Customers may request an eligible return after delivery under our 30-day Returns & Refunds Policy.
No separate cancellation fee is advertised for successfully canceled orders.
When a paid order is successfully canceled, applicable refunds are generally issued to the original payment method.
Refund timing depends on the circumstances, payment provider, and applicable legal requirements.
If an ordered product becomes unavailable, we will communicate the available options and provide an appropriate refund where required.
If an order cannot be shipped within the promised or legally required timeframe, customers will receive applicable delay notices and cancellation or refund options.
Contact us promptly if you need to correct order information.
Changes may not be possible after dispatch.
Rootedrealm
D & V Enterprises, Inc.
Tampa, FL 33618

blocks.text: Last Updated: November 17, 2026
At Rootedrealm, we aim to provide a straightforward and transparent checkout experience.
The payment methods currently supported by Rootedrealm are displayed during checkout.
Only payment options shown as available at checkout should be considered supported.
Product prices and payments are processed in US dollars (USD).
We provide free standard shipping throughout the United States.
Applicable taxes are displayed during checkout where required.
Payments may be processed through independent third-party payment providers.
These providers may perform payment authorization, verification, and fraud prevention checks.
We aim to use appropriate website and payment security measures.
Customers should complete purchases through the official Rootedrealm checkout.
Never send complete payment card numbers, security codes, or account passwords through a contact form.
After completing checkout, customers should receive order confirmation information.
If a payment appears successful but no order confirmation is received, contact customer support before placing another order.

blocks.text: Last Updated: November 17, 2026
Rootedrealm provides customer assistance for product inquiries, defective items, and applicable warranty information.
Warranty terms vary by product, manufacturer, and any warranty documentation supplied with the item.
Not all products necessarily include the same warranty period or coverage.
Customers should review individual product listings and manufacturer documentation.
Where applicable, a manufacturer warranty may cover certain qualifying defects.
Available remedies depend on the manufacturer's terms and applicable law.
Our team can assist with:
Product specifications
Compatibility questions
Missing accessories
Damaged or incorrect deliveries
Defective products
Return eligibility
Available warranty information
Order-related questions
If a product arrives defective, contact customer support with your order number and a description of the issue.
Photographs or videos may assist with the review.
Eligible defective returns are accepted within our standard 30-day return window.
Customers purchasing computer monitors, gaming consoles, 3D printers, RAM, scanners, and other electronics should review compatibility and manufacturer warranty information.
Chainsaws, pressure washers, snow blowers, and related equipment may require specific operating and maintenance procedures.
Always follow manufacturer instructions and safety warnings.
Fireplaces, wood stoves, and related heating equipment may require professional installation and compliance with local building and safety codes.
Installation is not included unless expressly stated.
Review dimensions, electrical requirements, installation instructions, and applicable warranty terms before purchase.
Eligible products may be returned within 30 days under our Returns & Refunds Policy.
Direct exchanges are not accepted.
If a problem occurs after 30 days, contact customer service to review any available manufacturer warranty or other applicable remedies.
Nothing in this policy removes rights or remedies that cannot legally be waived.
Rootedrealm
